static_traits.name: Lin Zeyu
static_traits.social_status: Good relationship with best friend Abigail; joined the school safety patrol
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychological counseling or treatment experience; similar psychological problems had not appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe the problem along a timeline; tone hesitant but willing to try; relatively high cooperation; thinking logic relatively coherent; has a negative self-evaluation tendency

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel I am a terrible Athlete, developing Self-doubt after poor performance in PE class or other physical activities.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts about athletic ability are affecting my self-esteem and my enjoyment of sports and activities, and I hope to improve this situation.
growth_experiences: After starting after-school martial arts classes, gradually generalizing one mistake in class into negation of overall ability, starting to label herself a 'terrible Athlete', and feeling embarrassed.

After joining the school safety patrol, feeling Increased stress about needing to perform well, worrying poor performance in the new role will bring negative evaluation; this pressure interacts with Self-doubt about sports performance.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, unlikely to improve in physical activities

special_situations.event: Making wrong moves in martial arts class or performing below Anticipation, and feeling embarrassed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes in front of others, it proves I have no talent and will never improve
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Displacing attention by reading novels, avoiding discussing Self-doubt with friends to reduce the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible, I will never get better.

special_situations.event: Performing below her own expectations in any sports activity or competition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One poor performance proves I am no good at all physical activities
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers participation enthusiasm, labels oneself negatively to avoid having hopes dashed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible at all sports.

special_situations.event: After joining the school safety patrol, feeling role expectations and performance pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly in the new role, everyone will think I am no good and be disappointed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing Self-monitoring and worry, avoiding seeking emotional support from friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not do well, everyone will look down on me.

special_situations.event: Being seen making a mistake by classmates or the coach in class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Making any mistake shows I am not suited for sports, failure equals total negation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blames himself and temporarily reduces engagement to lower the risk of making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Making mistakes proves I am not suited for sports activities.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen as capable, and accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure being seen, judged and humiliated by others
defense_goal: Avoiding stronger shame by lowering expectations and Self-denial
Stays cautious and avoids vulnerability exposure to maintain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: A participant prone to mistakes with insufficient ability
object_relations.object_representation: Others with evaluative and critical gazes (classmates/coaches/peers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment of practicing at home and recording it
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries this will become a 'test' of ability; once failed, will be negatively evaluated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: With a steady and accepting tone, first Empathize with her worry, then frame the experiment as 'Learning not testing', using concrete, achievable small steps, emphasizing that failure also provides information.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to describe strong feelings such as embarrassment and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing exposing vulnerability will bring discomfort or being seen as 'weak'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing down, using gentle Questioning, Guiding her to name feelings; allowing moderate Silence for experiencing space, validating her safety and permitting partial expression.

manifestations: Though having a Good relationship with friend Abigail, not yet sharing Self-doubt and shame
In sports contexts, isolates his own experience with self-labels; feels isolated inside
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of and engagement in sports activities

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently Self-doubting in counseling and repeatedly asking 'what if I still do not get better'
Tentative about behavioral experiments, committing cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Holding back the impulse to express troubles, not expressing Self-doubt to friends
Turning energy against the self through self-reproach and labeling

exception_events.target_problem: In sports activities (e.g. martial arts class) with poor performance, the client usually falls into 'I am a terrible Athlete' Self-denial and loses interest in participating.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After physical exercise, while distracting oneself by reading Harry Potter, the intensity of the negative thoughts decreased to some extent and the emotions were somewhat relieved, so that daily life could be resumed relatively calmly.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: displacing attention through immersive reading, briefly reducing focus on failure and emotional activation.

exception_events.target_problem: After encountering sports-related setbacks, the client usually blames themselves repeatedly and generalizes one mistake into overall poor ability.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When chatting with friend Abigail (though not yet directly discussing Self-doubt), emotions eased, negative thought intensity dropped, easier to recover than before.
exception_events.reason: Different support: gaining peer companionship and emotional support, social connection reducing self-immersion.

positive_force: Having stable peer support (Good relationship with Abigail)
Good academic performance, basically stable daily functioning
Willing to try counseling suggestions and behavioral experiments, with willingness for self-Reflection
Family support enabling her to attend and participate in Intervention
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions (overgeneralization, mind reading, black-and-white, predicting the future, self-labeling)
Highly sensitive to failure and embarrassment; overly focused on others' evaluations
Unwilling to disclose Self-doubt to close others, Social support not yet fully activated
Performance pressure from the new role (safety patrol) amplifying Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-labeling and repeated negation after sports activities (e.g. 'I am a terrible Athlete')
antecedent: Making mistakes in martial arts class or poor move completion
Performance in any sports activity falls below personal expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one mistake with black-and-white evaluation, with sensitivity to being evaluated and shame; role pressure (safety patrol) heightened Self-monitoring.
target_behavior.function: Briefly avoiding the Anxiety and shame brought by failure, lowering expectations for Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, reduced enjoyment and participation in sports activities

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing Self-doubt and negative emotions to close friends
antecedent: When an opportunity arises to communicate with good friend Abigail
Situations needing emotional support after sports setbacks
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying that exposing vulnerability will be evaluated or bring embarrassment, tending toward Self-monitoring and Retroflection
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of shame and Being rejected, maintaining surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: Social support hard to fully obtain, negative thinking maintained and worsened
